title: A Counterexample Over Every Field
statement: For every field k, the determinant-one rescaled construction formalized by Dean Cureton gives a polynomial map from k^3 to k^3 that is not injective.

members.title: A determinant-one counterexample over every field
members.statement: For every field k, the determinant-one rescaled construction formalized by Dean Cureton gives a polynomial map from k^3 to k^3 that is not injective.

members.title: Constant Jacobian determinant of the Alpöge map
members.statement: The displayed Alpöge polynomial map has Jacobian determinant equal to the constant -2.

members.title: An explicit triple collision
members.statement: The three distinct rational points (0,0,-1/4), (1,-3/2,13/2), and (-1,3/2,13/2) have the common image (-1/4,0,0) under the Alpöge map.

members.title: Failure of the Jacobian conjecture in dimensions at least three
members.statement: The Jacobian conjecture is false in every dimension n at least 3.
